items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: Now their favorite band during them days used to be Sam Morgan Band at the Sanchez Centers.

ctx.x: They just had the clubhouse and the meetings. Right.

They'd have a meeting right there, rent out their hall to a different organization or give their own dances like that. Now their favorite band during them days used to be Sam Morgan Band at the Sanchez Centers. Just like the Creole people down my way, if you hire any other band, they had better bands than Sam, but everybody could see Sam Morgan Band in my section, you see.
Who played Dronsfield Morgan's band most of the time?
well didn't he he played most of his numbers sort of slow boy

slow yeah not too fast similar like Sam Morgan band not for the high note men amongst all them fellas yeah two dangerous men's around there was Rene Kid Rene and Rick that's two high note men's amongst all them fellas but Rene he was a good executioner on his trumpet well them they called it the cornet yeah and Rick I was next to him they used to team to get lots on advertising when bands meet one another for the best and then another dangerous man we had arrived he was freakish on her was Kid Punch Kid Punch…
